appInfo.overviewText:
Kokage Map is a cross-platform map application built with Flutter.

It provides features such as GeoPackage-based data management, GPS surveying and track recording, external GNSS device connectivity, and offline map support.

detail.calibrationDesc: Calibration is performed on the device itself. These guides walk you through each step.
detail.tiltCalibrationDesc: Corrects the tilt sensor. Menu: DOWN 4s → "inC" → FIRE → "YES CAL" → FIRE. 8 positions on a flat surface.
detail.compassCalibrationDesc: Aligns the compass sensor. Menu: DOWN 4s → "H_Ang" → FIRE → "HACAL" → FIRE → "YES CAL" → FIRE. Outdoors, 8 positions facing North.
detail.measurementModeDesc: Choose what value the device displays and returns when you take a measurement.
detail.remoteControlDesc: Trigger measurement remotely from the app without pressing the device button.

mode.hdDesc: Flat map distance to the target, ignoring elevation. Most common for surveying.
mode.vdDesc: Height difference between device and target. Positive = target is above, negative = below.
mode.sdDesc: Direct line-of-sight distance from device to target. The raw distance the laser measures.
mode.incDesc: Vertical angle to the target in degrees. 0° = level, positive = uphill, negative = downhill.
mode.htDesc: Measures height of an object by shooting its top and base. Requires two measurements.
mode.azDesc: Compass bearing to the target (0°–360°). North = 0°, East = 90°, South = 180°, West = 270°.
mode.mlDesc: Distance between two remote points. Shoot both points from the same position to calculate.

tilt.step1Detail:
On the device:
1. Press-and-hold DOWN 4 sec → "UnitS" appears
2. Press DOWN until "inC" appears
3. Press FIRE → "no CAL" appears
4. Press UP or DOWN → "YES CAL" appears
5. Press FIRE → "C1_Fd" appears (calibration starts)
tilt.step2Title: Place on a flat, level surface
tilt.step2Detail:
Put the TruPulse on a flat, stable surface (within 15° of level).
Lenses facing forward. Make sure buttons are accessible for each position.
tilt.step3Detail:
Lenses face forward (away from you).
Wait ~1 sec until steady, then press FIRE.
LCD shows "C2_Fd".
tilt.step4Detail:
Rotate 90° so lenses face DOWN.
Wait ~1 sec, press FIRE.
LCD shows "C3_Fd".
tilt.step5Title: C3: Lenses BACK → FIRE  /  C4: Lenses UP → FIRE
tilt.step5Detail:
C3: Rotate 90° → lenses face BACK (toward you).
⚠ 360R: Hang buttons over edge of surface.
Wait ~1 sec, press FIRE (short press!).

C4: Rotate 90° → lenses face UP.
Wait ~1 sec, press FIRE. LCD shows "C5_Fd".
tilt.step6Title: C5: Rotate along optical axis → Lenses FORWARD → FIRE
tilt.step6Detail:
Rotate 90° ALONG the optical axis (roll the device).
Lenses should face forward again, but the device is now rotated 90° from Position 1.
Wait ~1 sec, press FIRE. LCD shows "C6_Fd".
tilt.step7Title: C6–C8: DOWN → BACK → UP → FIRE each
tilt.step7Detail:
Same rotation as C2–C4, but in the rolled orientation:

C6: Rotate 90° → lenses DOWN → wait, FIRE.
C7: Rotate 90° → lenses BACK → wait, FIRE.
C8: Rotate 90° → lenses UP → FIRE.

Device calculates result.
tilt.step8Detail:
PASS → Press FIRE to save and return.

FAiL1: Excessive motion (not held steady)
FAiL2: Magnetic saturation
FAiL3: Mathematical fit error
FAiL4: Convergence error
FAiL6: Wrong orientations

On FAIL → press FIRE, repeat from C1.
Abort anytime: long-press UP or DOWN (previous calibration restored).

compass.step1Detail:
Compass calibration must be performed outdoors.
Stand away from vehicles, fences, buildings,
electronics, and any metal objects.

Face towards Magnetic North (±15°).
compass.step2Detail:
On the device:
1. Press-and-hold DOWN 4 sec → "UnitS" appears
2. Press DOWN until "H_Ang" appears
3. Press FIRE → "dECLn" appears
4. Press DOWN → "HACAL" appears
5. Press FIRE → "no CAL" appears
6. Press UP or DOWN → "YES CAL" appears
7. Press FIRE → "C1_Fd" appears (calibration starts)
compass.step3Title: C1: Facing North, lenses FORWARD → FIRE
compass.step3Detail:
Hold the device facing North, lenses forward.
Wait ~1 sec until steady, press FIRE.
LCD shows "C2_Fd".
compass.step4Detail:
Rotate 90° so lenses face DOWN.
Wait ~1 sec, press FIRE.
LCD shows "C3_Fd".
compass.step5Title: C3: Lenses BACK → FIRE  /  C4: Lenses UP → FIRE
compass.step5Detail:
C3: Rotate 90° → lenses face BACK (toward you).
Wait ~1 sec, press FIRE.

C4: Rotate 90° → lenses face UP.
Wait ~1 sec, press FIRE. LCD shows "C5_Fd".
compass.step6Title: C5: Rotate along optical axis → Lenses FORWARD → FIRE
compass.step6Detail:
Rotate 90° ALONG the optical axis (roll the device).
Lenses forward again, serial port pointing UP.
Wait ~1 sec, press FIRE. LCD shows "C6_Fd".
compass.step7Title: C6–C8: DOWN → BACK → UP → FIRE each
compass.step7Detail:
Same rotation as C2–C4, in the rolled orientation:

C6: Rotate 90° → lenses DOWN → wait, FIRE.
C7: Rotate 90° → lenses BACK → wait, FIRE.
C8: Rotate 90° → lenses UP → FIRE.

Device calculates result.
compass.step8Detail:
PASS → Press FIRE to save and return.

FAiL1: Excessive motion (not held steady)
FAiL2: Magnetic saturation (field too strong)
FAiL3: Mathematical fit error
FAiL4: Convergence error
FAiL6: Wrong orientations

On FAIL → press FIRE, repeat from C1.
If it fails repeatedly, do Tilt Cal first.
Abort anytime: long-press UP or DOWN (previous calibration restored).

onboarding.welcomeDesc:
A GeoPackage-based geographic information management app.
Let's set up the required permissions to get started.
onboarding.storageDisclosure: Kokage Map requires full storage access to read and write GeoPackage files, save map cache, and manage project data.
onboarding.storageRequired: Basic app features are unavailable without this permission
onboarding.locationDisclosure:
Kokage Map collects location data to display your current position on the map, perform GPS surveys, record GPS tracks, and share your live location with party members.

Location data is stored on your device. Your live location is shared with room members only while you are in a location-sharing party.
onboarding.locationDeniedNote: GPS features will be unavailable. You can enable it later in Settings.
onboarding.bluetoothDisclosure:
Bluetooth permission is required to connect external GNSS devices (RTK receivers) and laser rangefinders.
You can skip this if you don't use external devices.
